roadmap.title: Survival campaign and core mechanics
roadmap.description: Learn the loop on the A New Dawn tutorial and clear all eight Survival levels while banking cumulative kills, cleanses and random situation decisions.

roadmap.title: Critical Mass campaign
roadmap.description: Play the ten Critical Mass levels for the bunker, bridge, clothing, museum and radio goals.

roadmap.title: Shadows of the Past campaign
roadmap.description: Play the ten Shadows of the Past levels for outposts, the Grand Settlement and drought survival.

roadmap.title: Seeds of Hope campaign
roadmap.description: Play the ten Seeds of Hope levels for the wildfire, bridge, Z-Com gear and campaign-completion achievements.

roadmap.title: Expeditions and leader wins
roadmap.description: Finish the daily Expeditions in every terrain type and at High Danger, then win with five different leaders.

achievements.summary: Reach a settlement population of 11.

steps.text: Build housing such as Tents and keep the settlement supplied until the population counter reaches 11/11.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Medicine resource by researching Technology level 4.

steps.text: Research technologies until @mechanic{Technology level 4} unlocks @item{Medicine}.

achievements.summary: Use the Take Quad Bikes special project at the Z Com Fortress on the Ancient Treasures level.

steps.text: Reach goal seven on @loc{Ancient Treasures}, the final Survival level, and claim the marked area.
Open @mechanic{Special Projects} and choose @item{Take Quad Bikes}.

achievements.summary: Complete the seventh goal on the Life After Death level to broadcast a radio signal.

steps.text: Play @loc{Life After Death}, the last Critical Mass level.
Finish its goals until the seventh goal broadcasts the radio signal.

achievements.description: Open a bunker that is better off closed
achievements.summary: Open the sealed bunker during the sixth goal on the Signs of Life level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Signs of Life}, the first Critical Mass level, and claim the marked area.
At the sixth goal, open @mechanic{Special Projects} and spend 5 Stamina to open the bunker.

achievements.summary: Complete the bridge barricade goal on the Dead Weight level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Dead Weight} and complete its goals until the sixth goal to barricade the bridge.

achievements.summary: Reach Technology level 6 on the Sunlit Grave level to discover the Clothing resource.

steps.text: Play @loc{Sunlit Grave} and reach its fifth goal by researching up to @mechanic{Technology level 6}, which unlocks @item{Clothing}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Museum of Civilisation special project on the Historic Legacy level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Historic Legacy} and reach the seventh goal.
Open @mechanic{Special Projects} and search for exhibits such as books, computers and newspapers to fill the Museum of Civilization.

achievements.summary: When the random Food Security for Settlement situation appears, choose Bug eating.

guide.context: The situation rarely appears unless food has been below zero for at least 20 days, so it cannot be forced quickly.

steps.text: Let Food drop below zero and stay in shortage for at least 20 days.
Refill the food storage and repeat if needed until the @mechanic{Food Security for Settlement} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Bug eating}.

achievements.summary: Choose the Conscription option in the Keeping Settlement Safe situation.

guide.context: The situation is likelier before the settlement has trained its first Fighter.

steps.text: Play any campaign until the @mechanic{Keeping Settlement Safe} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Conscription}.

achievements.summary: When the random Parents Want Children to Learn situation appears, choose Survive.

steps.text: Play until the random Parents Want Children to Learn situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Survive}.

achievements.summary: When the random Job Dissatisfaction in Settlement situation appears, choose Control.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Job Dissatisfaction in Settlement} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Control}.

achievements.summary: When the random Settlers Interested in Politics situation appears, choose Democracy.

guide.context: This situation cannot appear while playing as the Tyrant leader.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Settlers Interested in Politics} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Democracy}.

achievements.description: Show your people a photo of a Cute Kitten
achievements.summary: Choose the Worship Relics option in the random Cult of the Black Glass situation and get the rare cute kitten photo.

guide.context: The kitten photo is a 1% outcome of Worship Relics, so plan to retry. Save and exit at the event, reload, pick Worship Relics, and close the game without saving if the photo does not appear.

steps.text: Play until the random Cult of the Black Glass situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Worship Relics}, which costs 3 Stamina, and watch for the cute kitten photo on the phone.
If the photo does not appear, reload a save taken at the event and pick Worship Relics again.

achievements.summary: When the random Compulsive Washing in Settlement situation appears, choose Ban Washing.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Compulsive Washing in Settlement} situation appears and choose @mechanic{Ban Washing}.

achievements.summary: When the random Child Labour in Settlement situation appears, choose Make them work.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Child Labour in Settlement} situation appears and choose @mechanic{Make them work}.

achievements.summary: Choose the Make it official option in the Frog Collecting in Settlement situation and get the settlement renamed MegaFrogton.

guide.context: The rename to MegaFrogton is only one possible outcome of Make it official, so the choice may need repeating; reloading a save from before the event is the usual retry method.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Frog Collecting in Settlement} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Make it official} and check whether the settlement is renamed MegaFrogton.
If it is not renamed, reload a save from before the event and choose Make it official again.

achievements.description: See a survivor get an allergic response to bee stings
achievements.summary: Choose the Beekeepers option in the Bees discovered near Settlement situation and get the rare Anaphylaxis outcome.

guide.context: The situation only appears on maps with at least one Fruit area, and Anaphylaxis is a 1% outcome, so plan to retry. Save and exit at the event, reload, pick the option, and close the game without saving if the outcome does not appear.

steps.text: Play a level that contains a Fruit area until the @mechanic{Bees discovered near Settlement} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Beekeepers}, or Take honey, and watch for the Anaphylaxis outcome.
If nothing happens, reload a save from the event and pick the option again.

achievements.summary: When the random Grain farming for Settlement situation appears, choose Crushed Bones.

guide.context: The situation can only appear on a grain-producing area that has at least one level of grain production built.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{Grain farming for Settlement} situation appears and choose @mechanic{Crushed Bones}.

achievements.summary: When the random New Garden for Settlement situation appears, choose Playground.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{New Garden for Settlement} situation appears and choose @mechanic{Playground}.

achievements.summary: Choose the Creativity option in the New Statue for Settlement situation and get the horrible statue outcome.

guide.context: Creativity has several outcomes; the horrible statue is the unknown result where the settlers dislike the statue and take it down.

steps.text: Play until the @mechanic{New Statue for Settlement} situation appears.
Choose @mechanic{Creativity} and wait for the outcome.

achievements.summary: When the random Raising young children in Settlement situation appears, choose Neglect.

steps.text: Play until the random Raising young children in Settlement situation appears and choose Neglect.

achievements.summary: Explore every area on a single level.

guide.context: Play can continue after a level is won, so exploration can be finished in the same settlement.

steps.text: Explore every area on one level until the whole map is revealed.

achievements.summary: Win all eight levels of the Survival campaign.

steps.text: Win every Survival level, from @loc{A New Dawn} through @loc{Ancient Treasures}.

achievements.summary: Win all ten levels of the Critical Mass campaign.

steps.text: Win every Critical Mass level, from @loc{Signs of Life} through @loc{Life After Death}.

achievements.summary: Claim every area on a single level.

guide.context: Play can continue after a level is won, so claiming can be finished in the same settlement.

steps.text: Claim every area on one level until the whole map is under your control.

achievements.description: Have 8 constructions waiting to be built at once
achievements.summary: Have eight constructions waiting in the build queue at the same time.

guide.context: Leaving Wood short keeps constructions in the queue instead of building them instantly.

steps.text: Queue eight buildings at once, such as eight Tents, so eight constructions wait to be built.

achievements.summary: Win levels with five different leaders.

steps.text: Win five levels, choosing a different leader for each one.

achievements.summary: Kill a zombie for the first time.

guide.context: The A New Dawn tutorial map has no zombies, so the first kill comes on a later Survival level.

steps.text: Send a Fighter into combat and kill a zombie.

achievements.summary: Win any single level.

steps.text: Win any level by completing all of its goals.

achievements.summary: Lose a level by letting Authority fall to zero.

guide.context: Authority falls when the settlement's needs go unmet, such as when food, water or morale runs low.

steps.text: Start a level and let Authority fall to zero without winning.

achievements.summary: Cleanse one infested area with a Fighter.

steps.text: Move a Fighter to an @enemy{infested area} and use the @mechanic{Cleanse} action.

achievements.summary: Survive a Winter season.

guide.context: Winters appear on most campaign maps after the A New Dawn tutorial; stock food and fuel before the season starts.

steps.text: Keep the settlement alive until a full @mechanic{Winter} season passes.

achievements.description: Scavenge a resource 5 times in a single level
achievements.summary: Scavenge any resource five times in a single level.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Scavenge} five times in one level and collect each resource bubble when it appears.

achievements.summary: Cleanse infested areas until 25 total cleanses are complete.

steps.text: Keep cleansing infested areas across your playthroughs until 25 cleanses are complete.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 zombies.

steps.text: Keep fighting zombies across levels until 25 have been killed.

achievements.displayName: Maybe It's Not As Bad As All That
achievements.description: Kill 50 Zombies in a single level
achievements.summary: Kill 50 zombies within one level.

guide.context: Kills only count within one level and reset when you leave it, so pick a level with plenty of zombies.

steps.text: Kill 50 zombies within one level.

achievements.summary: Win a battle with two other Fighters supporting the attacking Fighter.

guide.context: You need three Fighters in total: one attacks while the other two wait in adjacent areas to support it.

steps.text: Train three Fighters.
Send one Fighter to attack an infested or zombie-held area.
Place the other two Fighters in the areas beside the target and win the battle.

achievements.summary: Explore the ruined Tutorial site in the west of the A New Dawn level and close its lore pop-up.

guide.context: The Tutorial site only appears in the western part of the map, which is reached through a bridge in the south-west.

steps.text: Replay @loc{A New Dawn}, the first Survival level.
Find the bridge in the south-west and cross it to reach the west side of the map.
Explore the western areas until a marker appears, wait for the lore window, and close it.

achievements.summary: Win any Expedition.

guide.context: Expeditions are the daily Beyond the Bunkers levels marked by their own icons on the map, with time limits and danger ratings.

steps.text: Pick any @mechanic{Expedition} and win it.

achievements.summary: Win an Expedition with a High Danger rating.

guide.context: Expeditions show a Danger rating before you start, so pick one rated High.

steps.text: Win an Expedition whose Danger rating is High on any difficulty.

achievements.summary: Complete every Expedition currently available.

guide.context: Complete the Expeditions shown on the map; if the achievement does not appear, also fill the Production, Society and Knowledge reward bars and finish the additional Expeditions.

steps.text: Win every @mechanic{Expedition} currently available on the map.

achievements.description: Settle an Expedition in every terrain type
achievements.summary: Settle an Expedition in a Forest, Mountain, Grassland, City and Swamp region.

guide.context: Each Expedition starts in one region type, and the five types to cover are Forest, Mountain, Grassland, City and Swamp.

steps.text: Start an Expedition and check the region type shown in the bottom-right corner.
Win Expeditions from each of the five region types.

achievements.summary: Survive a Drought season.

guide.context: Drought stops all water production and slows food and water scavenging, so stockpile water before the season starts.

steps.text: Keep the settlement alive through a @mechanic{Drought} until it ends.

achievements.summary: Establish an Outpost on the Stone Promise level.

steps.text: On @loc{Stone Promise}, reach the second goal and drag the Outpost onto the marked area.

achievements.summary: Complete the Grand Settlement goal on the Resolute Bastion level.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Resolute Bastion} by reaching population 14 while keeping morale at 80%.

achievements.description: Complete the Shadows Of The Past Campaign
achievements.summary: Win all ten levels of the Shadows of the Past campaign.

steps.text: Win every Shadows of the Past level, from @loc{Cracked Earth} through @loc{Forgotten Shadows}.

achievements.description: Find a clue to the past
achievements.summary: Find the clue to the past while playing the Seeds of Hope campaign.

guide.context: The clue appears during the Seeds of Hope story, which follows survivors uncovering Z Com's past.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Seeds of Hope} campaign.
Open and read any story clue pop-up that appears during the campaign.

achievements.summary: Cleanse an infested area that sits on a wasteland tile.

guide.context: Wasteland tiles cannot be claimed and damage Fighters that stand on them, and the Tangled Wastes level has far more wasteland terrain than usual.

steps.text: Play a Seeds of Hope level that contains wasteland areas, such as @loc{Iron Thorn} or @loc{Tangled Wastes}.
When an infestation sits on a wasteland tile, move a Fighter there and use the @mechanic{Cleanse} action.

achievements.summary: Kill a zombie with the wildfire on the Drifting Ember level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Drifting Ember} and let the wildfire spread between areas.
Lure a zombie into a burning area, or wait for one to walk in, and let the @mechanic{wildfire} kill it.

achievements.summary: Keep a bridge standing when the Mountain Pass level offers to blow it up.

guide.context: Mountain Pass triggers bridge pop-ups at goals seven, nine and eleven, and a bridge can be kept instead of destroyed.

steps.text: When a @mechanic{Blow the bridge} pop-up appears, choose the option that keeps the bridge standing.

achievements.description: Take the salvaged Z Com gear
achievements.summary: Take the salvaged Z-Com weapon from the Expedition Base on the Enduring Hope level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Enduring Hope} and reach the Defend the Expedition! goal.
During the third attack wave, take the salvaged Z-Com weapon at the Expedition Base and equip your Fighters.

achievements.description: Complete the Seeds of Hope Campaign
achievements.summary: Win all ten levels of the Seeds of Hope campaign.

steps.text: Win every Seeds of Hope level, from @loc{Broken Mile} through @loc{Enduring Hope}.
